description: This Java class, NoteController, is a REST controller in a Spring Boot application providing CRUD endpoints for note entities in a notes application. It defines endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving by ID, updating, and deleting notes, using the NoteService for business logic and integrating with Swagger for API documentation.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller exposing CRUD endpoints for notes, handling HTTP requests related to note operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new note with validated request data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of all notes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing note by ID with validated data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a note by its ID.
